text: 灰色小战士抓住你，把你拖走。他们逼你跪在两棵年轻桦树之间，将你的两只手腕分别绑在树上。一个小人提着月牙形长柄刀走近，恐惧在你胃里翻涌。吟唱声响起，你环顾四周。眼角瞥见长柄刀闪过，喉咙随即被冰冷的剧痛灼穿。之后，一片黑暗。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 265
text: The diminutive gray warriors seize you and drag you away. They force you to kneel between a pair of young birches and tie one wrist to each. Dread builds in your stomach as one approaches, carrying a moon-shaped blade on a pole. The start of a chant causes you to look around. Out of the corner of your eye, you see the pole-blade flash. An icy pain sears your throat. Then, blackness comes.
